standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the terms of the complex are acyclic for the global sections functor, so the total derived functor is computed termwise.

core_obligations: Choose a resolution: the proof takes a free resolution of the given module and observes that its pullback is a flat resolution, so the derived pullback is computed by that complex (proof lines 4628-4631)

Apply the threshold: for the chosen q the terms of the twisted complex are acyclic for global sections and their sections are the ideal power tensored with the resolution terms, both by the defining property of q(A, I) (proof lines 4632-4635)

Compute the total functor: the acyclicity lemma of the other chapter makes the total derived pushforward computed by the complex with terms the ideal power tensored with the resolution (proof lines 4635-4637)
Identify the answer: that complex computes the derived tensor product of the module with the ideal power by definition, which is the displayed isomorphism (proof lines 4638-4639)
proof_roadmap: 取 M 的自由分解 F_∙ → M，则 p^*F_∙ 是 \widetilde{M} 的平坦分解，Lp^*\widetilde{M}(q) 由 p^*F_∙(q) 表示。
由 q ≥ q(A,I)，各 p^*F_i(q) 对 Γ(X,-) 右零调且 Γ(X, p^*F_i(q)) = I^qF_i，于是 RΓ(X, Lp^*\widetilde{M}(q)) 由 I^qF_∙ 计算，而后者按定义计算 M ⊗^L_A I^q。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the total derived pushforward along the blowup of the twist of a pulled back quasi-coherent module with the derived tensor product of the module with the corresponding ideal power, for all twists beyond the threshold of the setup (author lemma at source lines 4618-4625, label lemma-compute-tor-Iq); the setup paragraph fixing the blowup and the threshold is reproduced as a context span. The proof (source lines 4627-4640) passes to a free resolution so that the derived pullback is represented explicitly, uses the two defining properties of the threshold to make each term acyclic for global sections and to identify its sections, and then invokes the acyclicity lemma of the chapter on derived categories of schemes to compute the total derived functor termwise (proof lines 4632-4637). The reduction to an explicit complex and the termwise computation are the content. H2.
